sv.title: Anthropic faller – Wall Street återhämtar sig
sv.summary: USA-börserna var på ett fortsatt uselt humör i fredagens inledande handel, men återhämtade sig relativt snabbt. AI-jätten Anthropic fick en smakstart på karriären som noterat bolag, men på fredagen var det andra bullar och aktien faller i den inledande handeln.

en.title: Anthropic falls – Wall Street recovers
en.summary: US stock exchanges were in a continued poor mood in Friday's opening trade, but recovered relatively quickly. AI giant Anthropic got a rocky start to its career as a listed company, but on Friday it was a different story, and the share falls in the opening trade.
